Contacten.note: What you see: Sanne sees her coaches, contacts and organisations, approves or declines a request and follows up an open invitation.

Contentpagina.note: What you see: Content page and Woo publication, save to a file

Cookieverklaring.title: Site: cookie statement

DocumentOndertekenen.title: My Zuiddrecht: sign a document

DqAfdelingen.note: What you see: the organisation as a tree of departments with, per department, the employees, their roles and whether they are in today.

DqCatalogus.note: What you see: the catalogue in folders (case types, attributes, templates, object types), the object types with their schema, and case types in and out of the Store as a file.

DqContact.title: dossiq: contact
DqContact.note: What you see: One person: details, cases, contact moments, documents; record a new case and contact.

DqContacten.title: dossiq: contacts

DqContracten.note: What you see: contracts with supplier, value and end date, tabs for suppliers and portal accounts, and renewing or terminating as a decision in decidiq.

DqDagAfsluiten.note: What you see: For each case or task you opened, record what happened.

The rest of this tab is on DqBeheerinstellingen.

DqProcesanalyse.title: dossiq: process analysis

DqTaak.title: dossiq: task

DqTaken.note: What you see: All tasks with six lenses, filter by case, status and priority.

DqTeamwachtrij.title: dossiq: team queue

DqZaakArchivering.note: What you see: Appraisal, retention period, selection list, legal hold and e-Depot; who held the case and who asks for it.

DqZaakBesluiten.note: What you see: The decision from decidiq with route and mandate, the formal decision with signing, advice.

DqZaakBetrokkenen.note: What you see: Parties per role, roles from the party model, case handler and team, access with origin and end date, followers.

DqZaakContact.title: dossiq: case, contact tab

DqZaakGerelateerd.title: dossiq: case, related

DqZaakHistorie.note: What you see: One history of the case, with export and read actions on request.

DqZaakLocatie.note: What you see: the Add location dialog: address search in the PDOK Locatieserver, the map with map layers, BAG, parcel and WOZ, and the warning for an address that does not come from the BAG.

Gesprek.note: What you see: A conversation with coach Mark Jansen with read status, PDF attachments and an input field with a file, next to the list of conversations and unread counters.

Home.title: Website: home
Home.note: What you see: Home page with a notice you can close, the "Arrange it now" catalogue, news, and for editors the button to edit the site

Machtigingen.note: What you see: Request access to cases, authorise someone

MedeOndertekenen.note: What you see: Sanne gets an email that Henk de Vries asks her to co-sign, signs in with DigiD and signs the application she cannot change, or declines.

MeldenZonderAccount.title: Site: report without an account
MeldenZonderAccount.note: What you see: Reporting wrongdoing without a name, coming back with a report code

MeldingGesprek.note: What you see: A reporter follows the conversation with the municipality via the report code, without an account, and sees what to expect.

MeldingIndienen.title: My Zuiddrecht: submit a report

MijnAccountZonderDigid.note: What you see: My account for someone signed in without DigiD: own details and what is not possible without DigiD.

MijnAfspraken.note: What you see: Sanne sees her service desk appointments with date, time, place and product, can reschedule or cancel them, and sees what the empty list looks like.

MijnGegevens.title: My Zuiddrecht: my details

PtBeheerdersrechten.note: What you see: The administrator limits admin groups to subjects and settings, sees whether everyone has two-step verification and reads the audit log of sign-ins, changes, outgoing requests and email.

PtBeheerinstellingen.note: What you see: The Portaliq section in the Nextcloud admin settings: the app's own signing key for portal sessions, revoking all sessions of an organisation, page editors, visitor origin and the internal server address, each section with its own save button.

PtBericht.title: portaliq: message
PtBericht.note: What you see: One message in a resident's inbox, with a Talk conversation between colleagues about the reply.

PtBeschikbaarheid.title: portaliq: availability
PtBeschikbaarheid.note: What you see: Availability per month and every outage

PtDashboard.title: portaliq administration: dashboard
PtDashboard.note: What you see: What needs attention today: requests, submissions, availability, traffic, accounts and sessions

PtFormulierInsluiten.title: portaliq: embed a form on your website
PtFormulierInsluiten.note: What you see: The list of application forms with the Embed form dialog: the code for your own website, the websites the form may appear on, and a preview of the form on www.zuiddrecht.nl after sending, with case number.

PtFormulierInstellingen.title: portaliq: form settings
PtFormulierInstellingen.note: What you see: The settings of the linked Woo request in portaliq administration, with the General tab filled in (form, case type, reference, sign-in methods, keep draft) and a short summary per other tab.

PtFormulierPrijs.title: Apply for a parking permit, step 2
PtFormulierPrijs.note: What you see: A form step with the permit types as choice cards with prices from the product catalogue, and a calculated duration and amount that update straight away, with a summary that also appears at check and pay.

PtFormulierYivi.title: Submit a Woo request, sign in with Yivi
PtFormulierYivi.note: What you see: The sign-in choice of a form with Yivi added, and the dialog that shows which three details the form asks for, with a QR code for the Yivi app; then the form fills them in.

PtGedeeldeBibliotheek.title: portaliq: shared library
PtGedeeldeBibliotheek.note: What you see: The shared library: styles and blocks with the portals that use them, one block selected, and a change that applies to three portals at once.

PtGegevensPdf.title: My Zuiddrecht: download your details as PDF
PtGegevensPdf.note: What you see: My details with the Download as PDF button and the dialog where Sanne chooses what goes into the PDF: details, cases, her plan and payments.

PtInloggenDemo.title: My Zuiddrecht: sign in to the demo
PtInloggenDemo.note: What you see: The demo sign-in page with a card for each way to sign in, a header with search box and a footer; the third card signs you in with one click as sample resident Sanne de Vries, with Only on this demo below it.

PtInstellen.title: portaliq: first-time setup
PtInstellen.note: What you see: The wizard on first opening, step 2 of 3 over the dashboard: two cards, None and Sample data with the number of objects, each with its own button; the sample data has just loaded.

PtIntegraties.title: portaliq: integrations
PtIntegraties.note: What you see: The integrations page of portaliq: the two connections the app registers (sign-in brokers and the visitor origin database) with their status, what needs attention and the way to integriq.

PtInzending.title: portaliq: submission
PtInzending.note: What you see: One submission with the fixed copy, the evidence log of the confirmation of receipt and the linked form.

PtInzendingen.title: portaliq: submissions
PtInzendingen.note: What you see: All submissions with the status of the confirmation of receipt; a failed confirmation stands out.

PtMailsjablonen.title: portaliq: email templates and send log
PtMailsjablonen.note: What you see: The administrator edits the email text per notification type with variables, schedules the digest emails and resends failed email from the send log.

PtMededelingen.title: portaliq admin: portal, announcements tab, dialog
PtMededelingen.note: What you see: Post announcements for the whole portal

PtMededelingenActies.title: portaliq: announcements, actions
PtMededelingenActies.note: What you see: Renew, import and export a portal's announcements, and copy or delete them in bulk.

PtMedia.title: portaliq: media
PtMedia.note: What you see: Media library, replace, do not delete what is in use

PtMediaKiezen.title: portaliq: choose media
PtMediaKiezen.note: What you see: From the page designer, choose an image from Media as main image, share image or in a text.

PtMeldingZonderAccount.title: portaliq: report without an account
PtMeldingZonderAccount.note: What you see: Handling a report without an account: deadlines, a conversation via the report code, and access to the reporter's identity only through the confidential adviser.

PtNieuws.title: portaliq: news
PtNieuws.note: What you see: Editing, publishing and unpublishing the portals' news items.

PtNieuwsbericht.title: portaliq: edit news item
PtNieuwsbericht.note: What you see: Writing or editing a news item, for everyone or for groups.

PtOpdrachtnemerProjecten.title: My projects as a contractor
PtOpdrachtnemerProjecten.note: What you see: The portal page where an external contractor sees the municipal projects they work on, with their own tasks and a form to log hours on a task (planninq, spec portal-contribution). They only see what the municipality has opened up for them.

PtPagina.title: portaliq admin: page layout
PtPagina.note: What you see: Edit the page layout, save or delete a draft, choose media

PtPaginaVerkeer.title: portaliq: page, traffic
PtPaginaVerkeer.note: What you see: Traffic for one page, where from and where to, experiment

PtPaginaZoekmachines.title: portaliq: page, search engines
PtPaginaZoekmachines.note: What you see: What Google shows, restore earlier versions

PtPortal.title: portaliq administration: portal, pages tab
PtPortal.note: What you see: One portal: traffic cards, start page check, pages, menus, media, news, announcements, glossary

PtPortalInstellingen.title: portaliq: portal, settings
PtPortalInstellingen.note: What you see: Portal details, house style with readability, domains, sign-in via integriq, session length, registration, case types, Berichtenbox, traffic measurement, installation

PtPortals.title: portaliq administration: portals
PtPortals.note: What you see: All portals, including umbrella portals, copying, importing

PtProduct.title: portaliq: edit product
PtProduct.note: What you see: The administrator edits one product with content and anchor menu, apply button, costs, conditions, locations, files, frequently asked questions, video, audience and publication.

PtProducten.title: portaliq: products and subjects
PtProducten.note: What you see: The administrator sees all products with subject, audience, form and publication status, and orders the subjects in a draggable tree with featuring, audience, case type and admin group.

PtRegioportaal.title: Site: working together in the region
PtRegioportaal.note: What you see: A public page of the region with software from the software catalogue next to news and publications from other apps.

PtSessies.title: portaliq: sessions
PtSessies.note: What you see: All sessions on My Zuiddrecht: whose they are, which assurance level, until when, and revoking them.

PtStemgedrag.title: Site: voting record of a council member
PtStemgedrag.note: What you see: A public page with a council member's voting record with a filter per meeting, the opened help for this page, and the chat with an answer from the site's own pages, sources and the way to an employee.

PtStore.note: What you see: The portaliq store: themes, page sets and form flows from other organisations, with a filter by type, what installing adds, preview and install.

PtThemas.title: portaliq: themes
PtThemas.note: What you see: Which house style each portal has and whether it is readable.

PtToegangsverzoeken.title: portaliq admin: access requests
PtToegangsverzoeken.note: What you see: Approve or reject requests with a reason

PtUitnodigen.title: portaliq: invite someone
PtUitnodigen.note: What you see: Inviting someone to My Zuiddrecht with email address, organisation and audience.

PtUitnodigingen.title: portaliq: invitations
PtUitnodigingen.note: What you see: All invitations employees sent, with status and expiry date, and revoking them as long as they are not accepted.

PtVerkeer.title: portaliq: traffic
PtVerkeer.note: What you see: Traffic for a portal: cards, per day, pages, missing pages, search terms, paths, sources, visitors, goals, forms, dimensions, script errors, experiments, heatmap, recordings and reports

PtVoorstelBeoordelen.title: portaliq: reviewing proposals in dossiq
PtVoorstelBeoordelen.note: What you see: On the case in dossiq, accepting the changes proposed by residents and colleagues, or rejecting them with a reason.

PtZaaktypeWeergave.title: portaliq: case type display
PtZaaktypeWeergave.note: What you see: Per case type the administrator sets what the resident sees: statuses with colour, text, button and notification, document types with upload rules, the confidentiality limit and the explanation for each result.

Publicatie.title: Website: publication
Publicatie.note: What you see: Reading and downloading a Woo publication, and keeping it in your file.

SessieVerloopt.title: My Zuiddrecht: session expires
SessieVerloopt.note: What you see: Warning before sign-out, stay signed in

TaakAfronden.title: Task: send a copy of your ID
TaakAfronden.note: What you see: Sanne opens the task to send her ID, sees which files are allowed, adds one and completes the task, after which the answer is with the case.

ThemaOverzicht.title: My Zuiddrecht: parking
ThemaOverzicht.note: What you see: The Parking theme page with your open tasks, what you can arrange, your two parking permits with their validity, and Parking as its own group in the side menu.

Toegankelijkheid.title: Site: accessibility statement
Toegankelijkheid.note: What you see: The standard page with the accessibility statement.

Uitkeringen.title: My benefit
Uitkeringen.note: What you see: Sanne downloads her monthly statements and annual statements as PDF, with an explanation and the sentence that the data comes from the benefits administration.

WooVerzoek.title: Woo request: step 1 of 3
WooVerzoek.note: What you see: Submit a Woo request, step 1: what do you want to know.

WooVerzoekControleren.title: Woo request: check and send
WooVerzoekControleren.note: What you see: On the check page Sanne ticks that her answers are correct and that she agrees to the privacy statement.

WooVerzoekGegevens.title: Woo request: step 2 of 3, your details
WooVerzoekGegevens.note: What you see: Submit a Woo request, step 2: your details, filled in beforehand where we know them.

WooVerzoekVerstuurd.title: Woo request: confirmation
WooVerzoekVerstuurd.note: What you see: After sending, Sanne sees a large reference, that a confirmation email was sent, the status of co-signing and payment, a PDF download and at the bottom the question how she found the form.

Zaak.title: My Zuiddrecht: your case
Zaak.note: What you see: Your case with status steps, at the current step the button Send the missing documents and the next step in grey, details, documents, earlier contact moments, ask a question and the actions objection, complaint, change and withdraw.

ZaakAfgerond.title: Your case: city centre parking permit, completed
ZaakAfgerond.note: What you see: The completed parking permit case with the granted decision and the explanation at the top, the decision as the first document to download, no more withdrawing or adding, but you can still ask a question.

ZaakIntrekken.title: My Zuiddrecht: withdraw application
ZaakIntrekken.note: What you see: Withdraw an application with an optional reason

ZaakVolgen.title: My Zuiddrecht: follow a case
ZaakVolgen.note: What you see: Following one case with case number and email

ZaakWijzigingVoorstellen.title: Your case: propose a change
ZaakWijzigingVoorstellen.note: What you see: A resident proposes a change to their own case, sees their own proposals and waits for the municipality to review them.

Zelfdiagnose.title: Self-test: parking at your home
Zelfdiagnose.note: What you see: A step in the self-test with radio buttons, help text, the path of earlier answers and starting over.

ZelfdiagnoseResultaat.title: Self-test result: parking
ZelfdiagnoseResultaat.note: What you see: The advice at the end of the self-test with related products, an attachment, downloading your answers as a PDF, starting over and, for signed-in residents, saving to My files.

Zoeken.title: Website: search Woo publications
Zoeken.note: What you see: Search with suggestions under the search box, filters by type, category, organisation and period, results with pagination, and at the bottom the question whether you found what you were looking for, with thumbs up, thumbs down and a comment field.

ZoekenGeenTreffers.title: Site: search without results
ZoekenGeenTreffers.note: What you see: Search without results: tips, and saving the search to get a message when there is news.
